step1_analysis.description: A single NMOS transistor used as a switch or reset device. In the context of the paper, it is likely used to characterize subthreshold leakage or to reset an analog storage node where minimizing OFF-state leakage is critical.

paper_reference.title: A 10-nW 12-bit Accurate Analog Storage Cell With 10-aA Leakage

sky130_expected.calculation: Standard subthreshold leakage for SKY130 NMOS at Vgs=0V is typically in the pA/um range. For W=5um, L=0.5um, expect roughly 10pA - 100pA at room temperature.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 10 aA reported in the paper was achieved using specific leakage-cancellation techniques or zero-Vds biasing in an older 1.5um process. In a standard 130nm process at Vds=1.8V, standard OFF leakage will be significantly higher (pA range).
Calculated using first-order square law model for SKY130 NMOS parameters.

V_th.description: Threshold voltage of the NMOS transistor

sky130_expected.calculation: Standard threshold voltage for sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 is approximately 0.42V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on SKY130 PDK documentation for the 1.8V standard threshold NMOS device.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure OFF-state leakage, ON-state resistance, and threshold voltage of the NMOS switch.
step3_testbench.spice:
* NMOS Switch Characterization Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 VOUT VRESET GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

* Voltage Sources
VRESET VRESET 0 DC 0
VOUT VOUT 0 DC 1.8

.control
* 1. Measure OFF-state Leakage (VRESET=0V, VOUT=1.8V)
op
let i_leakage = -i(VOUT)
print i_leakage

* 2. Measure ON-state Resistance (VRESET=1.8V, VOUT=0.1V)
alter VRESET = 1.8
alter VOUT = 0.1
op
let r_on = 0.1 / -i(VOUT)
print r_on

* 3. Measure Threshold Voltage (VOUT=1.8V, sweep VRESET)
alter VOUT = 1.8
dc VRESET 0 1.8 0.01
let id = -i(VOUT)
* Find Vth at a constant current threshold (e.g., 1uA * W/L = 10uA)
meas dc vth_meas find v(VRESET) when id=10u

quit
.endc
.end
